structured_output.content: The environment's values set the key `global.rbac.disableHTTPChallengesRole`, and the v1.18.0 release notes say this Helm value is new in that release. In v1.18.0 the value disables HTTP-01 ACME challenges so that cert-manager can drop its permission to create pods. Whatever value you set will take effect after the upgrade. Check the value configured for `global.rbac.disableHTTPChallengesRole`, and if it disables the role, confirm that no Issuer or ClusterIssuer relies on HTTP-01 challenges. The summary only lists cert-manager.io/v1 Certificate manifests and does not show your issuers.
